questions: How many TBG devices did you measure in total, and in the 1.6 to 3° range, and how many showed positive photoresistance and T² resistivity below the umklapp threshold?
Why were the other devices or datasets set aside, if any were?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: frequencies other than 0.14 THz, the absolute value of Pmax, lattice temperatures above 2 K for the photoresistance in Fig. 2a,b, and fillings and temperatures for Fig. 3b,c?
What does the second-best device look like for the T² claim, for example ρ − ρ0 against T at |ν| ≈ 0.1 in another 1.6 to 3° device?
What value of ρ0 did you subtract in Fig. 3b,c, how was it chosen, and does a fit with a free exponent (or the local slope d ln(ρ − ρ0)/d ln T) still give 2 when ρ0 is varied within its uncertainty?
How large is the lattice temperature rise in the TBG channel at Pmax, and does ΔρTHz(n) follow dρ/dT(n) times a single temperature rise across all fillings, including where ρ is linear in T?
What does ΔρTHz look like in the 1.58° device at |ν| ≈ 0.1 and 3.8, where you report T² resistivity, given that the 2° inset of Fig. 2a shows a negative response near the CNP?
Have you estimated the Te-dependent screening of charged impurities at |ν| ≈ 0.1, where your T_F/2 marker in Fig. 3b puts T/T_F near 0.5 at the top of the fitted range?
